input.task: Create a local service page discoverable by search engines and answer systems.

expected_behaviors: Provide specific title, description, canonical handling, and crawlable navigation
Make WHO, WHAT, WHERE, SERVICES, and HOW TO CONTACT clear where supported
Keep local and entity claims aligned with project sources
forbidden_behaviors: Promise rankings or inclusion in AI answers
Use keyword stuffing or hidden text
Invent an address, reviews, awards, phone number, or service area
objective_checks: Metadata and visible headings have one coherent page intent
Unsupported facts are absent or marked unknown
